_comment: Ilsabet Frostmere, the rime vow knight (SLICE_PLAN 3.7, kit sheet docs/heroes-v2/kits/ilsabet_frostmere.txt). The kit fields are the slice fixture's (src/test/resources/heroes/slice/ilsabet_frostmere.json); art and animations are source only (HEROES_V2 12.5, 12.6). One body for good (the owner's rule of 2026-11-13, HEROES_V2 3.6): an adult of ordinary size, standard build, drawn at 104%.
name: Ilsabet Frostmere
title: the Rime Vow
description: A knight-commander who swore to keep the weak behind her shield.

ultimate.name: Vow of Winter
ultimate.line: By my vow, winter holds this line!

transition.line: Then I will stand against you properly.
To me, Rime Vow! Hold the line!

intro.line: Lower your weapon and I will lower mine. I keep my word.

quirks: polishes her shield every night, whether it needs it or not

leader.title: Knight-Commander of the Rime Vow
leader.motto: No one falls while we stand.

founding: By my oath, this is the Order of the Rime Vow. No one here will be left behind.
greeting: {player}. Are you well? Good. Stay that way.
last_stand: My word is given. Not one step back.

ils.sb_raise._comment: Shield Bash's tell: the shield raised high before her, its top over her head, the left shoulder turned to the target and the knees bending, the sword held back low at her right side.

ils.sb_coil._comment: Shield Bash's tell held: lower on the knees, leaning back behind the raised shield, coiled.

ils.sb_lunge._comment: Shield Bash lands: the shield driven straight forward at chest height with the left shoulder and the hips behind it, deep on the front knee, the sword held back.

ils.sb_drive._comment: Shield Bash driven through: the shield a little further on, the body low behind it.

ils.sb_recover._comment: Shield Bash's recovery: straightening behind the shield, the sword coming back up to her guard.

ils.os_wind._comment: Oath Strike's wind-up: the sword raised high at her right, the blade back over the shoulder, the chest turned right behind the shield.

ils.os_cut1._comment: Oath Strike, the first cut: diagonal, down and across to her front left, the chest turned into it, the shield drawn aside to the left.

ils.os_low._comment: Oath Strike between the cuts: the blade carried on low at her left, the wrist turning for the rising cut.

ils.os_cut2._comment: Oath Strike, the second cut (the freeze): rising from low left to high right, the chest turned right behind it, the shield back before her.

ils.rw_lift._comment: Rime Wall's wind-up: the shield lifted high before her, the sword raised back, the chest open.

ils.rw_set._comment: Rime Wall set: the shield slammed down before her like a wall, its point low, deep on the knees, the sword raised upright behind it.

ils.ts_coil._comment: Turning Sweep's tell: the hips and chest wound far to her right, the sword drawn back low behind her right side, the shield tucked up high at her left shoulder, the eyes on the target.

ils.ts_coil2._comment: Turning Sweep's tell held: lower, wound a little further.

ils.ts_a._comment: Turning Sweep: the blade out at her right, level, the body turning with it (knees deep, feet planted).

ils.ts_b._comment: Turning Sweep: the blade at her front right, the body turning with it (knees deep, feet planted).

ils.ts_c._comment: Turning Sweep: the blade straight before her, the body turning with it (knees deep, feet planted).

ils.ts_d._comment: Turning Sweep: the blade at her front left, the body turning with it (knees deep, feet planted).

ils.ts_e._comment: Turning Sweep: the blade out at her left: the half circle done, the body turning with it (knees deep, feet planted).

ils.ts_f._comment: Turning Sweep's follow-through: the blade carried on round behind her left side and slowing.

ils.fl_set._comment: Frost Lance Charge's tell: she sets herself low behind the shield, the sword levelled past its right edge like a lance, the head down behind the rim.

ils.fl_run_a._comment: Frost Lance Charge, the run in place (the server carries her): the left knee driving up, the right leg pushing back, the shield and the levelled sword held steady.

ils.fl_run_b._comment: Frost Lance Charge, the run in place (the server carries her): the other stride, the shield and the levelled sword held steady.

ils.fl_plant._comment: Frost Lance Charge stops: the shield slammed down point first into the ground before her, braking on deep knees, the sword drawn up behind it.

ils.fl_rise._comment: Frost Lance Charge's recovery: rising behind the shield.

ils.fs_raise._comment: Frozen Standard's tell: the sword raised high before her, point down, the chin up, the shield held out at her left.

ils.fs_plant._comment: Frozen Standard planted: the sword driven point first into the ground before her, the knees deep, the shield held out, the head up.

ils.fs_pull._comment: Frozen Standard's recovery: the sword pulled up out of the ground, rising, the shield still out at her left (it comes back before her as she settles into her guard).

ils.cg_raise._comment: Call the Guard: the sword thrust straight up over her head, the shield swept out wide, the chest open and the chin up: "To me!"

ils.cg_point._comment: Call the Guard's command: the sword swept down to point at the foe, the shield coming back.

ils.vw_vow._comment: Vow of Winter's opening, the vow: the sword upright before her face, the shield lowered at her side, the head a little bowed.

ils.vw_raise._comment: Vow of Winter's tell: the sword raised straight up over her head, the shield out low and wide, the chin up.

ils.vw_peak._comment: Vow of Winter, the last instant of the tell: the sword tipped back over her head, the body drawn up.

ils.vw_strike._comment: Vow of Winter strikes: the sword swept down in a great arc to point at the ground before her, deep on the knees, the shield swept wide.

ils.bw_brace._comment: Bulwark: the shield set forward and low, the sword laid over its top, the knees deep, braced.

ils.p2_nod._comment: Phase 2: the sharp nod that snaps the visor down, the sword upright before her face.

ils.p3_rally._comment: Phase 3: the sword thrust up over her head, the shield out wide, the chest open: "To me, Rime Vow! Hold the line!"

ils.salute._comment: The salute: the sword upright before her face, its guard at her chin, the shield lowered at her side.

ils.in_lower._comment: The intro's offer: the sword lowered, its point to the ground at her right front, the shield at her side: "Lower your weapon and I will lower mine."

ils.vi_rest._comment: Victory: the sword's point set on the ground before her, the hand on the pommel, the shield at her side, the head bowed: "It is done."

ils.ta_point._comment: The taunt: the sword levelled at the foe, the arm straight, the shield before her.

ils.ta_flick._comment: The taunt's beckon: the sword's point flicked up: come.

ils.ls_lean._comment: The last stand: bent over and breathing hard, leaning on the sword planted point down by her right foot, the shield hanging low at her side, the head down.

ils.tap_reach._comment: Personal 1: the right hand reaching behind her to the shield on her back, the knuckles at its lower edge, a glance back over her right shoulder.

ils.fist_heart._comment: Personal 2: the salute without a blade: the right fist over her heart, the head a little bowed.

ils.glance._comment: Personal 3: a glance back over her right shoulder at her allies, the chest turning with it.

ils.visor_down._comment: sec.loop: the helm's visor held down on its hinge (+visor_up).

ils.p2_open._comment: sword_shield.stance with the visor at -75 degrees on its hinge.

ils.p2_salute._comment: ils.salute with the visor at -75 degrees on its hinge.

ils.p2_salute_h._comment: ils.salute with the visor at -75 degrees on its hinge.

ils.p2_snap._comment: ils.p2_nod with the visor at 6 degrees on its hinge.

ils.p2_snap2._comment: ils.p2_nod with the visor at -2 degrees on its hinge.

ils.p2_shut._comment: ils.salute with the visor at 0 degrees on its hinge.

ils.p2_shut_h._comment: ils.salute with the visor at 0 degrees on its hinge.

ils.p2_end._comment: sword_shield.stance with the visor at 0 degrees on its hinge.

ils.glance_nod._comment: Personal 3: the nod in the glance back.

ils.vi_up._comment: Victory: the head up again over the resting sword.

ils.p3_low._comment: Phase 3: sword_shield.stance, the standard -14.0 px from its place, the banner at 0.15 of its length.

ils.p3_up._comment: Phase 3: ils.p3_rally, the standard -1.0 px from its place, the banner at 0.80 of its length.

ils.p3_over._comment: Phase 3: ils.p3_rally, the standard 1.2 px from its place, the banner at 1.08 of its length.

ils.p3_hold._comment: Phase 3: ils.p3_rally, the standard 0.0 px from its place, the banner at 1.00 of its length.

ils.p3_end._comment: Phase 3: sword_shield.stance, the standard 0.0 px from its place, the banner at 1.00 of its length.

move.shield_bash.description: Shield Bash (move slot 0, a dash of 3, heavy: 0.8 / 0.2 / 0.8 s): the shield goes up high before her, its top over her head, the left shoulder turned to the target and the sword drawn back low (0.25 s), lower and coiled behind it (the tell, to 0.62 s); driven straight forward at chest height with the shoulder and the hips behind it at 0.70 s (hit, tick 16: the server carries her 3 blocks), on through (cast, tick 19); she straightens behind the shield and is back in her guard by 1.7 s. Feet planted (the server moves her).

move.oath_strike.description: Oath Strike (move slot 1, a combo of 2, light: 0.45 / 0.35 / 0.4 s): the sword raised high at her right with the blade back over the shoulder (0.2 s), a diagonal cut down and across to her front left at 0.35 s (hit, tick 9), the blade turned low at her left, and a rising cut back up to her high right at 0.65 s (the second hit and its freeze, tick 15); held a beat, and back to her guard by 1.1 s. A swing sound before each cut. Feet planted.

move.rime_wall.description: Rime Wall (move slot 2, a nova of 5 that taunts, with a shield for her allies, light: 0.6 / 0.1 / 0.5 s): the shield lifted high before her and the sword raised back, the chest open (0.28 s); the shield slammed down before her like a wall, deep on the knees, the sword raised upright behind it, at 0.50 s (hit, tick 12: the ice forms, the rime_wall sound), cast at 0.55 s; held a beat, and back to her guard by 1.1 s. Feet planted.

move.turning_sweep.description: Turning Sweep (move slot 3, a sweep of 4 through 180 degrees over 1.0 s, area: 1.0 / 1.0 / 0.8 s): the hips and chest wind far to her right with the sword drawn back low behind her right side and the shield tucked up at her left shoulder, the knees sinking (0.4 s, held and trembling to 0.85 s: the tell, as the frost gathers); the blade comes out level at her right at 0.90 s (hit, tick 20, the frost_sweep sound) and turns steadily through the front to her left with the body unwinding behind it (cast at 1.85 s, tick 39), carried on round and slowing; back to her guard by 2.7 s. Feet planted.

move.frost_lance_charge.description: Frost Lance Charge (move slot 4, a charge of 14 at 170%, heavy: 1.0 / 0.8 / 1.0 s; phases 2 and 3): she sets herself low behind the shield with the sword levelled past its right edge like a lance and the head down behind the rim (0.35 s, held and trembling: the tell); the charge at 0.90 s (hit, tick 20) and a driving run in place behind the shield while the server carries her, to 1.65 s (cast, tick 35); she stops by slamming the shield point first into the ground before her and braking on deep knees (the shield_plant sound, the move's end), rises behind it and is back in her guard by 2.7 s.

move.frozen_standard.description: Frozen Standard (move slot 5, a zone of 6 round her for 10 s, area: 1.2 / 0.1 / 0.8 s; phase 3): the sword raised high before her, point down, the chin up and the shield held out at her left (0.45 s, held to 1.0 s: the tell, the standard on her back stirring); driven point first into the ground before her at 1.10 s (hit, tick 24: the frozen field spreads), cast at 1.15 s; held with the head up while the frost spreads, pulled out at 1.6 s and back to her guard by 2.0 s.

move.call_the_guard.description: Call the Guard (move slot 6, she calls three soldiers of her faction, light: 0.6 / 0.1 / 0.4 s; phase 3): the sword thrust straight up over her head and the shield swept out wide, the chest open and the chin up (0.3 s), held for the call at 0.50 s (hit, tick 12: the server's horn), cast at 0.55 s; the sword swept down to point at the foe (0.72 s), and back to her guard by 1.0 s.

ultimate.description: Vow of Winter (the ultimate, a nova of 6 that freezes, with a shield for her allies within 8: 1.6 / 0.2 / 1.5 s): the sword brought upright before her face with the eyes closed, the vow (0.35 s); raised straight up over her head with the chin up and the shield out low and wide, the line spoken ("By my vow, winter holds this line!", 0.9 s), trembling as the ring of ice grows, tipped back at the last instant (1.38 s); swept down in a great arc to point at the ground before her as she drops deep on her knees at 1.50 s (hit, tick 32: the frost bursts out; the release is the server's sound), cast at 1.65 s; held low while the frost settles, rising, and back to her guard by 3.2 s.

state.bulwark.description: Bulwark (played as phase 2's transition ends, "Then I will stand against you properly."): she drops into a braced shield wall, the shield set forward and low, the sword laid over its top, the knees deep (the server's armour sound), settles, and rises into her guard by 1.5 s.

phase.2.description: Phase 2 (inside the 1.2 s transition: "Then I will stand against you properly."): the helm's visor is raised as the phase begins; the sword comes upright before her face (0.3 s) and she gives one sharp nod that snaps the visor down at 0.45 s (the visor sound), the visor bouncing shut on its hinge, then lifts her head and settles back into her guard by 1.1 s (Bulwark follows).

phase.3.description: Phase 3 (inside the 1.4 s transition: "To me, Rime Vow! Hold the line!"): the sword thrust up over her head and the shield out wide (0.35 s, the rally horn), while the standard rises up behind her out of its socket on her back with a small overshoot and its banner unfurls; the blade's edge glows with frost from here on; held, and back to her guard by 1.3 s.

intro.description: Intro ("Lower your weapon and I will lower mine. I keep my word."): the salute, the sword brought upright before her face with the eyes closed and the shield lowered at her side (0.35 s, the intro sound), held; the eyes open and the sword is lowered, its point to the ground at her right front, an offer with a small nod (1.0 s); back to her guard by 1.5 s.

victory.description: Victory ("It is done."): the sword lowered and its point set on the ground before her, the shield at her side, the head bowed toward the fallen (0.45 s, held); she looks up with a gentle smile (1.3 s) and is back in her guard by 2.0 s.

taunt.description: Taunt: the sword levelled at the foe, the arm straight over the shield (0.35 s), held a beat; its point flicked up twice, beckoning (0.75 s, 0.95 s): come; back to her guard by 1.5 s.

last_stand.description: Last stand ("My word is given. Not one step back."): bent over and breathing hard, leaning on the sword planted point down by her right foot, the shield hanging low, the head down (0.3 s to 0.7 s); up straight into the braced shield wall, the shield set forward and the sword laid over it (1.0 s), held, and back to her guard by 1.6 s.

personal.1.description: Idle quirk, the shield tap: a glance back over her right shoulder as the right hand reaches behind her to the shield on her back and raps its lower edge twice with the knuckles (the shield_tap sound), a satisfied nod, and the hand falls back to her side.

personal.2.description: Idle quirk, the salute: the right fist brought over her heart and the head bowed (the salute sound), held a breath, and lowered.

personal.3.description: Idle quirk, the glance back: she looks back over her right shoulder at her allies, a small nod and a gentle smile, and faces front again.

sec.loop.description: The helm's visor held down on the secondary controller (it plays all the time, last, keying only p2_visor_hinge): turned +visor_up on its hinge, so the visor is down from phase 2, when the helm shows, whatever the other controllers play; phase.2 swings the visor itself from raised to shut on it.
